create_linear_chain_crf: create a LinearChainCRF distribution with log potentials and optional sequence lengths for structured prediction
run_forward_sequential: run the sequential forward algorithm on a LinearChainCRF with O(n t^2) complexity for log-partition computation
run_forward_parallel: run the parallel forward algorithm on a LinearChainCRF with O(log(n) t^3) complexity for numerically stable log-partition
mask_out_base_struct: mask out parts of a base structure array that do not fit the sequence lengths in batched CRF computation
build_crf_event_shape: build a LinearChainCRF and retrieve its event shape from log potentials for sequence length and state count inspection
